_README: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the app's Model Analysis tab. Do NOT hand-edit the per-model error numbers in production — regenerate this file by running `python model/export_metrics.py` ON THE CLUSTER (where the dataset lives) after you retrain. The app reads this file and computes avoidable-bias/variance live, so: retrain -> export_metrics.py -> commit -> reboot app -> tab updates automatically.
generated: seed (from RESULTS.md + all_results.json) — run export_metrics.py on the cluster to refresh with measured train error

task.name: Door-Hanging Safety Classifier
task.description: Binary image classification: is a passenger hanging on the door of a bus/leguna (unsafe) or not (safe)?
task.split: 70/15/15 stratified (train 269 / val 58 / test 58); deep models use 5-fold CV on the 327 train+val for a reliable estimate
task.primary_metric_note: Because data is imbalanced 2.9:1, watch UNSAFE-RECALL (catching violations), not just accuracy. A 'always safe' model already scores 74.5% accuracy while catching 0 violations.

human_level.definition: Careful expert reviewing the full-resolution image (can zoom). Used as the Bayes-error proxy.
human_level.why_not_zero: Irreducible error is above 0: the annotations themselves contain mistakes (e.g. legua/IMG_3719 is an empty parked leguna labelled 'unsafe'), and some unsafe hangers occupy only 1-8% of a cluttered frame. Even expert humans miss/dispute these.
human_level.how_to_measure: Have 2-3 teammates label a 40-50 image blind sample (run `python model/export_metrics.py --hlp-sample 50`); the inter-annotator disagreement rate is your empirical human-level error. Update this field with the result.

error_analysis.summary: Of 83 unsafe images, only ~6 score below 0.5 confidence. The biggest, cheapest win is fixing mislabelled images (~11-13), NOT more modelling — AUC plateaued at ~0.93 across 6+ architectures, the signature of a data ceiling.

categories.ceiling: Recovers recall + raises the usable threshold

diagnosis.reasoning: Deep models nearly match human level, but AUC plateaus at ~0.93 across 6+ architectures (ResNet50/ConvNeXt/EfficientNet, 320px, ensembling, TTA, box-crops, tiling). The binding errors are mislabelled or tiny/distant. More model capacity does not help — the signature of a variance/data ceiling.
next_actions: Collect more clear UNSAFE images (currently only 98).
Fix the ~11-13 mislabelled images surfaced by the label audit.
Deploy the high-recall (95%) operating point behind a human-review queue rather than chasing accuracy.
diagnosis.note_classical_vs_deep: Classical HOG models (SVM/Logistic/NB) sit far below human level on dev too -> those are BIAS-limited (too weak). Deep models are variance-limited. This contrast is the point: different models live in different bias/variance regimes.
